title: Two Lobbies
hints: Echo runs every block you place, at the same time as LoopBot.
Both lifts are three tiles ahead.

story.intro: PATCH: "Twin Spires, two towers joined by a skybridge. See the bot in the other lobby? It was built from your plans, and its radio copies yours. Call it Echo."
story.outro: PATCH: "One program, two bots. Echo did everything you told LoopBot to do."
